method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); one date helper in a small module, the rules in one module and the family member's questions in a seat module importing it; one regulative rule (the s 9 time limit, with the permission to seek an extension as its LEST) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics were read; satisfied assertions were counted by distinct source range. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: Focus: the provisions a claimant meets; the whole operative claims machinery of the Act. In: ss 4(1), (2) (in descriptions), 7(1)-(4), (7), (8), 8(1)-(3), 9, 10(1), 13, 14, 16, 17, 19, 20, 21, 22(1) (in description). Out: ss 1-3, 5, 6 (machinery, application, transitional); ss 11, 15 (the beneficiary's burden and commutation: a beneficiary seat); s 12 (class fund); s 18 (certified copy); s 22(2), (3) (evidence); ss 8(4), 10(2) noted only. Reasons in NOTES.md.
